---
title: "Search"
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
listing:
  contents: ../posts/*/index.qmd
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  image-height: 0px
  fields: [date, title, description, categories, reading-time]
  page-size: 20
---

<input id="post-search" class="post-search" type="search" placeholder="Search posts by title, description, or category…" autocomplete="off" />

```{=html}
<script>
  window.document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const input = window.document.getElementById("post-search");
    if (!input) return;

    const LISTING_ID = "listing-listing";
    const SEARCH_COLUMNS = [
      "listing-title",
      "listing-description",
      "listing-categories",
    ];

    const getList = () => {
      const listings = window["quarto-listings"] || {};
      return listings[LISTING_ID];
    };

    const run = () => {
      const list = getList();
      if (!list) return;

      const q = input.value || "";
      list.search(q, SEARCH_COLUMNS);
    };

    // Quarto initializes listings on DOMContentLoaded as well; ensure we're
    // attached even if our handler runs first.
    const waitForListing = (attemptsLeft = 50) => {
      if (getList()) {
        run();
        return;
      }
      if (attemptsLeft <= 0) return;
      window.setTimeout(() => waitForListing(attemptsLeft - 1), 50);
    };

    input.addEventListener("input", run);
    input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        input.value = "";
        run();
        input.blur();
      }
    });

    // If the user arrived with a query param (?q=...), prefill.
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const q = params.get("q");
    if (q) {
      input.value = q;
      // Defer running until the listing is definitely available.
    }

    waitForListing();
  });
</script>
```
